chapters.name: The stairs, the van and the garage roof

youtube.title: What If GTA6 Physics Were Real?
youtube.intro:
You fall down the stairs and get up without a scratch. A green health bar appears over your head, and after every hit it simply refills. Game physics in real life sounds like a superpower, until you work out where all that energy has to come from.

Part of the GTA in Real Life series: what would actually happen if the rules of an open-world crime game worked in our world? Watch the whole series in the playlist.

An original story with original characters. Not affiliated with, endorsed by or connected to Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive. Please don't try any of the stunts in this video.
youtube.pinned_comment:
If you had a respawn bar for one day, what's the first thing you'd try? 👇

And what do you think happened to Ellie's bar? Best theory gets pinned before the next episode.

The physics is real: a 54 mph crash stops you in a few hundredths of a second, which is hundreds of g, and the most a human has survived on purpose was 46.2 g (John Stapp, 1954). Sources are in the description.
